summary: Full backend + frontend regression on the Autonomous PR Security Reviewer. 19/19 pytest cases pass after correcting one test payload. All targeted UI flows (Overview KPIs & health, Reviews filters, Simulator run end-to-end, Review detail tabs + trace + disabled publish for simulation, Analytics charts, Policies CRUD + similarity probe backed by supabase-pgvector, Settings health + webhook + Supabase SQL) render and behave as specified. Node-express simulation completed in ~108s and produced 14 MCP tool violations (bandit/semgrep/eslint/pattern mix) and 7 LLM findings with severity/CWE/suggested_code. Python-flask simulation validates supervisor->tooling->rag->synthesis->validator->finalize trace all SUCCESS, tool_violations from bandit+semgrep, retrieved_policies with backend=supabase-pgvector and non-zero cosine scores, non-zero tokens/cost, validation_attempts<=3, and 100% line-anchor compliance (every finding file_path==submitted and line within file range). Webhook HMAC accepts valid ping (200 pong), rejects missing/tampered signatures (403), ignores closed PRs, and de-dupes on X-GitHub-Delivery. Policies search returns 5 ranked hits with backend=supabase-pgvector and SQL-injection-related top hit.

minor.issue: If a pull_request payload is missing repository.owner.login the handler raises KeyError and returns 500 (see server.py:278). GitHub always sends it, but a hardened webhook should 400 with a validation error instead of 500 to avoid noisy alerts on malformed inputs.

design_issues.screen: Review detail (multiple tab panels) and Analytics
issues: Recharts logs repeated 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on initial mount because ResponsiveContainer briefly measures a zero-size parent (tabs mounted while hidden). Non-blocking, but sets minWidth/minHeight or aspect to silence and avoid a first-paint layout jump.

action_items: Optional hardening: validate repository.owner.login (and other required GitHub webhook fields) in server.py github_webhook handler and return 400 on missing keys instead of a 500 stack trace.
Optional polish: give Recharts ResponsiveContainers a minHeight or explicit height on tab panels to suppress width=-1 warnings and prevent first-paint reflow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py github_webhook: `repo['owner']['login']` is dereferenced before schema validation. Wrap with Pydantic model or .get(...) with an HTTPException(400) so malformed payloads don't produce 500s and pollute logs.

GET /api/reviews list endpoint drops findings/tool_violations from each row (returns 0/0) while GET /api/reviews/{id} has full data. This is fine but should be documented / typed so future callers do not assume list rows carry findings.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 review runs (python-flask x2, node-express x1 via API, node-express x1 via UI) and one custom policy 'TEST_UI_Custom_Policy' that was created and then deleted through the Policies UI. All TEST_ prefixed policies created via pytest are cleaned up in class teardown.
test_credentials: n/a - dashboard is open (no auth). External keys already in /app/backend/.env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and runs under the pre-configured pytest.ini (xdist -n 2 loadscope). Simulate runs take ~50-120s each (real Gemini calls), so keep poll timeouts >=150s. Webhook idempotency test requires repository.owner.login in the payload or the handler 500s (open bug). Frontend: TID map in /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds.js; all interactive elements have data-testid. Recharts width=-1 warnings on tab panels are cosmetic.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no blocking failures. The only backend imperfection is missing input validation for GitHub webhook repository.owner.login, which surfaces as 500 rather than 400 when the field is absent. Fix: guard the field extraction with Pydantic model_validate() or dict.get() and raise HTTPException(400).
